Interface LogBuilder<B,O>

Type Parameters:
B - builder
O - created on build
All Known Implementing Classes:
DisruptorLogBuilder, EcsEncoderBuilder, FileOutputBuilder, GelfEncoderBuilder, JfrAlertListenerBuilder, LogAppender.Builder, LogbackJsonEncoderBuilder, LogstashEncoderBuilder, PatternConfigBuilder, PatternEncoderBuilder, RollingFileOutputBuilder
public interface LogBuilder<B,O>
A marker interface for custom or generated builders.
See Also:
  • LogConfigurable
API Note
This interface is for discovery and documentation so that one can find all the builders supported by Rainbow Gum.
